text:
Sadly a massive disappointment.

First of all it’s a very busy location so up to 10-15 minutes just to order then the food can take up to 20 minutes (if they don’t forget about you, which they have done before). I’ve visited here multiple times and every time I visit Marrakesh. I go because it’s often quicker than some places and relatively cheap. However the food isn’t the same and has a slight unusual taste compared to the UK.

I visited two occasions on my last trip and on my first I had missing items which I didn’t realise until I got back to my apartment, and second time it was that busy down stairs I went to the first and second floor as it was quieter. I chose to sit on the second floor as the top floor was dirty with many trays and tables not cleaned.

When sitting on the second floor you routinely see staff just laying about with their legs up blasting music. I decided to move further round a corner only for the ignorant member of staff to move and sit next to them which was near me. It made me feel very uncomfortable and certainly the staff’s professionalism was not good.

I decided to walk out and I will not be returning.

Highly unprofessional, unclean and unorganised.

Returned today (6 months since m last encounter). Only just arrived and thought I’d get a coffee as I seen people walk out. Only to be yelled at by security saying it’s not open. There’s a way to talk to people and his attitude stinks. Only come for convenience but the past occasions has made me want to stay way clear and never want to give them my custom again.
author: Gregory James

text: Tous les mcdos a travers le monde sont connus pour leur bon service surtout de la part des employés et leur rapidité! Mais ce que j'ai vu dans ce mcdo hier le 12 janvier 2026 a 19h était hors du commun. Tous dabord 2 machines de commandes qui ne marchent pas (aucun ticket de commende ne sort)! Puis quand je vais à la caisse pour payer il n y a personne à la caisse et les employés (de la caisse + ceux qui se chargent de la cuisine frites glaces et boissons) sont en train de rigoler entre eux devant tout le monde a haute voie alors qu'il y avait une grande queue et beaucoup de monde était en train d'attendre. Ce n'est qu'après 2 minutes que quelqu'un (je pense que c'était le manager qui était en avec eux tout le temps et regarder sans rien faire) a demandé à une employée (vulgaire moche et impolie) de s'occuper la caisse pour prendre l'argent et activer les commandes. Quand c'est à mon tour de payer je lui montre le ticket je paie mon cornet de glace et elle dit à une autre employée: un cornet de glace pour "celui-là". Je fais la remarque que "celui-là" ne se dit pas pour adresser quelqu'un car c'est impoli. puis elle se tourne vers son collegue qui etait chargé du menage et lui dit à haute voie "apparemment celui-la n'apprecie pas qu'on l'adresse par celui-la". Je pense qu'il faut de l'ordre dans cet endroit.
author: Younes

text:
Commande passée chez McDo via Glovo : résultat, il manque littéralement la moitié de la commande. Pas une frite oubliée hein, la MOITIÉ.

Le pire ? Aucune solution. Ni remboursement, ni geste commercial, ( 7dh de dédommagement ) ni même un vrai “désolé”. On te balade, on te répond à moitié, et au final tu paies pour du vent.

C’est simple : tu commandes, tu paies, et tu croises les doigts pour recevoir ce que tu as payé. Sinon, tant pis pour toi. Zéro respect du client, zéro professionnalisme, zéro suivi.

Franchement, si vous n’êtes pas capables de préparer une commande complète ou d’assumer vos erreurs, autant fermer le service livraison. Parce que là, c’est juste du foutage de gueule.
author: Hatim

text:
I had low expectations, but somehow McDonald's still managed to disappoint. Ordered a lot of food an every thing was a disaster, a Big Mac meal, and it was a disaster from start to finish. The burger was cold, the bun was stale, and the lettuce was practically wilted. The patty was dry, barely had any sauce, and honestly tasted like it had been sitting out for hours.

The fries? Soggy and barely salted. Not the crispy, golden fries they advertise. To make things worse.

Service was good!! For the price, I expected at least something decent, but it was a complete waste of money. Definitely not coming back.
author: Shab Hussain

text:
The entire food order was ruined. I ordered a chicken burger but received meat instead. Secondly, we ordered two drinks and only one arrived. The ice cream was also missing, even though we ordered it. They didn’t believe us, and in the end they tore up our receipt because we went to the counter to complain twice. The funny part in all of this is that I ordered an M&M ice cream, and nowhere was it mentioned that they were peanut M&Ms. Luckily, I’m not allergic to peanuts — but do not order this if you have a nut allergy.
Today, January 30th at 8:00 PM.🥴🙄
author: Fanni Aulén

text: J’ai commandé à manger sur Glovo, le livreur n’a rien touché. Le paquet était scellé. Or McDo m’a livré un paquet de frites vide et il manquait mon burger. Je suis extrêmement déçu. Comment est-ce possible en 2025 qu’une énorme chaîne comme McDonald’s se permet d’employer des personnes qui oublie la moitié de la commande je ne vous conseille pas ce McDo mieux vaut aller le manger en Europe, les couscous et les tajine sont beaucoup plus abordables et 1000 fois moins cher, et vous êtes sûre qu’il manquera pas un grain de couscous McDo à la con.
author: Mateo Neto

text:
Je fais ce post pour dénoncer ce qui se passe au Mc Donald's de la gare de Marrakech en espérant que le siège Marocain réagisse car c'est inacceptable, récurent et visiblement pas prêt de changer!!!
J'ai régulièrement des soucis de commande dans ce point de vente de la gare et je n'ai jamais donner mon avis mais là trop c'est trop...
J'ai joint quelques photos entre le filet o fish balancé façon boomerang et les grandes portions à moitié pleine c'est la goutte qui fait déborder le vase!!!
Vous faites honte à cette franchise internationale!!!
author: Mus 26

text: Chaotic, only one machine of 6 worked and there was queue for it. Counter tills were not opened, with at least half of the staff standing and chatting or 2 or three completing one order. Our order was prepared and left on the counter and no one shouted the order number leaving us to wait for more than 25 mins. Only Moroccans were  getting the attention and being served as VIPs, because we appeared as non locals we were ignored and given bad attitude for asking if the order was ours. Very poor customer service. I wouldn’t not recommend
author: Adel Sedrati

text:
Pure chaos. Instead of using the actual receipt/order numbers system, the numbers are bumped from the screen immediately when they show up before they're actually served, so instead they have employees walking from a customer to a customer asking for their receipts to find their orders.
Place is dirty, their stereo system is broken, speakers just buzzing on the 3rd floor.
We've ordered a couple of items including their deluxe coffee - see a photo attached for a good laugh.
author: Matt

text: Ordered a meal with a Coke Zero — the first came flat, warm, and with no ice. Asked for another and it was still flat. When I complained, the manager kept insisting that because the first one was warm it wasn’t possible to “feel the fizz.” That makes no sense — Coke Zero should be carbonated no matter the temperature. In the end I was offered bottled sparkling water, but honestly, what’s a McDonald’s meal without a proper cold fizzy drink? The whole thing ruined the meal.
author: N G

text:
Zero stars there's no air con or it wasn't working today.  Waited ages for the food, it's ok nothing special.  There's better food that's much cheaper available locally.  Avoid at all costs, I only went for the kids sake.
There was a bunch of teenage boys messing about, then one by one sat Infront of us watching us eat??!!  Felt uncomfortable & then a lady warned me to be careful as they also decided to leave when we did.  V odd
author: M s

text: I had a bad experience this morning. I didnt get all of my order and had to wait for more than 20 minutes knowing that there was no queue. Too much chatting between the crew members and i observed people preparing meals touching it with naked hands. When i told them that i got incomplete parts of my order they were sceptical about it. Weak and bad service. I think they need supervising because they harm the image of the company.
author: El Mehdi Ait Benlaarbi

text: Usual fast food and unhelpful staff. The quicker you remove unhappy employees and use more digital ordering that works...the better. Due to screen not accepting payment, when trying to pay for order the server continued to talk to a 'friend' which made the whole process very awkward.  Once ordered there was nothing 'fast' about this place...waited forever... 20 mins for our food to arrive!
author: Marc Forrester

text: Waited for 25 mins in front of the counter for 1 wrap. Spoke to 3 different staffs and twice to the same manager. Everyone just took a look at the receipt and went on with their work without a response. Finally one of the fellow customer who was about to leave came and raised their voice for me as they saw me standing there while they were waiting for their order. Such a bad experience.
author: Janifa Raju

text: Absolute mess, both the food and the staff. First of all, the order was incomplete. When it finally arrived, the food was cold. And when I asked a staff member for a straw because they’d forgotten to include one, and we were sitting upstairs on the rooftop terrace, she literally rolled her eyes and walked away, never bringing the straw. Complete garbage.
author: Hakim L.

text:
Nous avons commandé quatre plats, mais ils n'étaient pas à la hauteur. Les jus étaient presque exclusivement à base d'eau. Même le responsable était absent, et c'est l'agent de sécurité qui a servi les plats sans respecter les règles de sécurité sanitaire.
Les matières premières et les marchandises entrent par la porte des clients !
author: Luxury Rentals

text: I waited for my order for an hour. Then I spoke to the manager. I told three different staff members that my order included a decaf cappuccino (among other items). After another 15 minutes of waiting, I finally received my order. And it contained a caffeinated espresso. Probably it's the worst McDonald's in the Universe. Ever.
author: vitriolvm

text: Locale freddo, personale poco professionale abbiamo atteso quasi 40 minuti per un hamburger e una cioccolata perché loro dovevano guardare la partita alla TV! Locale freddissimo in una giornata di pioggia già fredda di per sé, aria condizionata a 18 gradi a dicembre! Ma che senso ha? Prezzi alti cibo scadente!
author: Tatiana Longhi

text: Franchement très déçue de ma commande. Ce n’était même pas la bonne ! Il manquait plusieurs articles, et ce que j’ai reçu ne correspondait pas du tout à ce que j’avais payé. Aucune vérification avant la livraison, c’est vraiment dommage. Je ne commanderai plus chez ce McDo si le service continue comme ça.
author: Hanane Adam

text: C’est une honte ! J’ai reçu une commande qui n’était même pas la mienne, avec des trucs en moins en plus ! Je paie pour un service correct, pas pour qu’on me livre n’importe quoi. Franchement, aucun sérieux, aucun respect du client. C’est la dernière fois que je commande chez ce McDo !
author: hiba chakir

text: Nie polecam. Totalny chaos, brud, długie czekanie a burger chyba smażony razem z rybą. Napój wodnisty. Najgorsze czekanie i bałagan przy zamówieniach i odbiorze. Jadłem w wielu MacDonaldach w całej Europie i nawet najgorsze francuskie czy hiszpańskie MacDonaldy są lepsze.
author: Florian Wierzchowski

text: It's my first time here and it's will be my last time , I was waiting like 30 minutes to get one hamburger and one Coffe they forget my commend , they serve food like this way  that you see on the picture,my recommendation don't go to here if you are new in the marrakech
author: lahcen ait said

text: The absolute worst mc donalds i have ever visited! I got very bad food poisoning! I have been in the toilet for the past 3 days. No hygien standards. Please dont eat there! Ruined my whole vacation! How is this even possible? I wish i could give it zero stars.
author: Antti H

text:
Service nul  👎🏿 très très mauvaise organisation.
Personnel très mal encadré.
J’ai du me servir moi même, sans sauces ni serviettes, ni paille. Sinon on oublie les plateaux sur le comptoir jusqu’à ce qu’ils deviennent froids 👎🏿👎🏿👎🏿👎🏿👎🏿👎🏿👎🏿
author: china mogurd45

text: Terrible, waited 35 min for my food, they had to ask me multiple times what my order was because the machine broke and messed up the receipt, food was then cold and manager was very rude when I asked for a refund. Tourists avoid.
author: louis ball

text: Watched the guy pick up a fry from the filthy counter, then handle every nugget and fry with his bare, unwashed hands — right after touching a sweaty dude and everything in sight. Absolutely no hygiene standarts
author: Marija Milenkovic

text: Cold burgers meat served, street cats inside the shop, missing items on the tray, i have had food from many places in Marrakech they all served good meals. Avoid McDonalds and try some other chains!
author: Safwan Serji

text: You deserve a permanent closing. That's not food it's disgusting,and the brand is Zio's friendly. In conclusion, you have every worst quality that makes you deserve less than a half star 🔻🚫
author: Mr BowShock

text:
this place is chaotic and unsafe,
the service was poor the place was packed, the machines weren’t working and the area in itself is very scary especially at night girls be careful !
author: GiGi

text: People always cut in lines. Staff does nothing about it. Half filled chips. Food and drinks always runs out. Been there couple of times. There was no Coca cola available one time.
author: A SA

text: Gave me severe food poisoning on my holiday. Was up from 3 AM vomiting for 12 hours. Ruined a good chunk of my holiday. Avoid like the plague
author: Harry Davis

text: They made us pay for the meal four times becaus, they put  a machine that doesn’t work...it was really a bad experience and very big scam
author: Hamza Rawan

text: Ordered my meal and waited nearly 30 minutes. Ended up getting a refund and didn’t receive my meal , awful service
author: Cassie Merrifield

text: With very long waiting times, employees bring food just for themselves and rest more than they actually work.
author: Marcelina Dombrzalska

text: rude, disgusting workers and managers. They hate their jobs and clients.Maroco?Never again! disgusting
author: Denis Baszkow

text: I waited for 1 hour to get my order and the place was not even busy , poor costumer service 😒
author: Soufiane Labroum

text: Good food , tasty meals of burgers , plenty of choices but very dirty toilets
author: Abdallah Mehdi

text: Taking 30 min and 3 requests for one simple ICE cream. Worst Service
author: Ouzo

text: Very crowded , the food was horrid and the staff where beyond rude
author: Skye Pretlove

text: 20 minutes for messing the order, never coming back
author: Szymon Jasiński
